results.title: VIGGO Cleaning Robots Log Over 20,000 Operating Hours at Beijing's CapitaMall Taiyanggong
results.description: BEIJING, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Two VIGGO SC50 autonomous cleaning robots have logged more than 20,000 operating hours at CapitaMall Taiyanggong, supporting daily floor care at a shopping mall that welcomes over 30,000 visitors a day. Deployed nearly two years ago, the robots have become part of the mall's regular housekeeping operations, automating routine dust mopping while staff focus on detailed cleaning and immediate service needs. Operating records show that the two units have completed nearly 4,000 cleaning tasks, covering a cumulative 13.28 million square meters—equivalent to approximately 1,860 standard football pitches. The figures reflect repeated cleaning across the mall's public areas over the deployment period. Located in Beijing's Chaoyang District, the seven-level mall has a gross floor area of approximately 80,000 square meters. Heavy foot traffic creates recurring cleaning demands, from dust and grit carried through entrances to hair and small debris around retail areas. Promotional displays, storefront fixtures, and the constant flow of shoppers add further complexity to cleaning during business hours. The SC50 robots operate on the mall's first and second floors, starting at 7 a.m. before shoppers arrive. Each works for more than 12 hours daily, autonomously docking to recharge before resuming their routes. Repeated dust-mopping passes help limit the buildup of dust and light debris throughout the day. The robots detect and avoid pedestrians, allowing cleaning to continue during opening hours. No robot-related safety incidents have been reported during the deployment. For the mall's housekeeping team of more than 30 people, the deployment has also enabled a clearer division of work. The two robots offset a workload equivalent to four full-time cleaning positions. Staff can devote more time to entrance carpets, narrow spaces beside storefronts and escalator areas, while responding promptly to spills in dining areas and requests from shoppers. This arrangement reduces the physical demands of repeatedly cleaning large public areas and gives the team more flexibility during weekends and holidays, when foot traffic intensifies. Routine floor maintenance continues alongside tasks that require staff attention. Cleaning data and task histories also give managers a record of completed work, supporting checks on cleaning frequency and task tracking. At CapitaMall Taiyanggong, the deployment demonstrates how autonomous cleaning can seamlessly integrate into established retail operations: sustained daily coverage, more flexible staff allocation and documented performance over nearly two years of use. results.title: JinkoSolar Completes Name Change to Jinko Holdings Limited
results.description: ADSs continue to trade under "JKS"; Company to Enhance Transparency on Strategic Investment Portfolio SHANGRAO, China, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jinko Holdings Limited ("Jinko Holdings" or the "Company") (NYSE: JKS), formerly JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd., today announced that its new company name has taken effect following shareholder approval at its annual general meeting on October 21, 2026. The Company's American depositary shares ("ADSs") will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the new name on October 23, 2026, with the ticker symbol "JKS" and CUSIP number unchanged. The Company has also adopted "晶科控股有限公司" as its dual foreign name. The new name reflects the Company's evolution into a holding company that better reflects its industrial foundation with a controlling interest in Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. (SSE: 688223), complemented by a growing portfolio of strategic investments in AI, renewable energy, advanced materials, and other frontier technologies. Going forward, the Company intends to provide investors with quarterly updates on selected developments across its strategic investment portfolio, including value-realization events. The Company believes greater transparency will provide investors with a better understanding of its capital allocation priorities and how its investments contribute to shareholder value. "Jinko Holdings better reflects who we are today," said Dimi Du, Chief Executive Officer of Jinko Holdings Limited. "Technology is reshaping the value and applications of energy, from power generation to AI computing. We believe the growth of AI will bring energy and computing infrastructure ever closer together. As a holding company anchored in clean energy and investing in frontier technologies, we aim to pursue the new opportunities emerging from this convergence. We will maintain a disciplined approach to capital allocation, actively manage our investment portfolio and seek capital recycling opportunities, with the goal of enhancing capital efficiency and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders." The change of the Company's name does not affect the rights of the Company's existing shareholders or ADS holders. All existing share certificates bearing the former name of the Company will continue to be valid. About Jinko Holdings Limited Jinko Holdings (NYSE: JKS) is a holding company combining clean energy industrial operations and strategic investment in emerging technologies. Its industrial foundation is a controlling interest in Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. (SSE: 688223), a global leader in clean energy technology. The Company makes disciplined strategic investments in renewable energy, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, commercial space and other frontier technologies, drawing on its industrial experience and its ability to identify emerging technologies and bring them to commercial scale. Through Jinko Solar Co., Ltd., the Company distributes its solar products and sells its solutions and services to a diversified international utility, commercial and residential customer base in China, the United States, Japan, Germany, the United Kingdom, Chile, South Africa, India, Mexico, Brazil, the United Arab Emirates, Italy, Spain, France, Belgium, Netherlands, Poland, Austria, Switzerland, Greece and other countries and regions. Through Jinko Solar Co., Ltd., the Company has over 20 overseas subsidiaries in Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, India, Turkey, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, the United States, Mexico, and other countries, and a global sales network with sales teams in China, the United States, Canada, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Italy, Germany, Turkey, Spain, Japan, the United Arab Emirates, Netherlands, Vietnam and India, as of September 30, 2026. results.title: Diogo Jota's wife Rute reveals her final message to him and how she learned of his tragic death
results.description: Liverpool and Portugal football star Diogo Jota died in a tragic car crash in Spain last year alongside his younger brother, Andre Silva, while they were travelling in a Lamborghini to catch a ferry back to the UK. In the biography 'Diogo Jota: Forever In Our Hearts,' Jota's wife, Rute Cardosa recalled her final message to him.
creator: mamta naik
